built_on: the control host of the emulated cluster (LXD 5.x, nested lab nodes)
built_from_note: origin/main (266fa55) merged with the agent task-surface change set of PR #170 (t_1a2c913c); that is the tree that carries agent/src/termini_agent/taskapi.py, the tasks: block in config/agent.yaml.template and the result-sink hook in provision/30-termini-agent.sh. Rebuild from main after #170 lands.
why: agent-runtime.md 5.6 / 7.4 (PR #170): the runtime exposes POST /v1/tasks on its loopback listener (127.0.0.1:9101) with a per-instance tasks.max_concurrent bound. The w4 bake has no such surface.
PR #164: the wired model alias is `gemma`; deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro are retired and refused with ModelNotAllowed instead of being substituted. The w4 bake still names deepseek-flash.

what_the_guest_now_ships.in_image_selftest: provision/35-agent-selftest ran the runtime's own suite inside the bake, including image/agent-vm/agent/tests/test_taskapi.py -> passed

acceptance.how: infra/agent-vm/tools/run-w5-republish.sh (place on A/B -> FRESH `lxc launch agent-os/w5` per node -> infra/agent-vm/tools/accept-w5.sh). Nothing was copied into the instances.

points.point: 1. termini-agent.service is active inside a newly created instance
2. /etc/termini/agent.yaml names gemma, allowed_models [gemma] and a tasks.max_concurrent bound
3b. and LIVE from inside the instance
3c. and REFUSED from outside the instance (from the node that hosts it)
points.observed: curl: (7) Failed to connect to 10.20.1.187 port 9101 after 0 ms: Couldn't connect to server / http=000 (same for :9101/status)

points.point: extra: the surface really runs a task (it cannot fake an answer)
points.observed: POST /v1/tasks -> 202 {"task_id":"01M52V40DZS7YXMZCXPWZXMHWA","state":"queued"}; then state=error, code=INFERENCE_UNREACHABLE after 2022 ms ('inference endpoint http://10.10.0.13:8080 is unreachable: timed out'), i.e. no on-prem inference in the lab; enumeration then reports count=1 and /status reports tasks.failed=1 while the log lines stay content-free (prompt_bytes only)

points.point: extra: the bake still boots with zero network fetches

acceptance.before_contrast: w5-live/before-w4.txt — the same probes against a fresh agent-os/w4 instance: config names deepseek-flash / [deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro], no tasks: block, and GET /v1/tasks -> http=404.

alias_policy.decision: Publish the rebuilt image on the nodes as agent-os/w5 and keep agent-os/w4 in place.
alias_policy.not_changed: controller/app/config.py DEFAULT_LXD_WORKLOAD_IMAGE stays agent-vm/2026.10.0 (pinned by tests/test_workload_image_default.py to image/agent-vm/evidence/image-manifest.json). A controller driving a node's local store must carry TERMINI_LXD_WORKLOAD_IMAGE=agent-os/w5.

cost: no GCP compute started or created: the build ran on this host's LXD and the acceptance ran on the lab footprint (demo-node-a / demo-node-b, nested LXD containers).
